      Keys and gestures

      Tap the body
      Names the muscle there; the card lists what lies under it too
      Click a dot
      Walks to it; the graph turns around it
      Scroll, drag
      Moves the graph; a flick glides
      Pinch, ⌘ scroll
      Zooms about the pointer
      ← ↑ → ↓
      Step to the tie that way, Enter opens it
      ⇧ arrows
      Move the graph
      + − 0
      Zoom in, out, fit
      ⌘[ ⌘]
      Back and forward along your path
      /
      Search
      F
      Turn the body round
      H
